method: Political representation B; native rivers and relative jurisdictions, not a new projection fit or urban locator as GCP

options.meaning: Freising temporal urban nucleus on the western/northern Isar sector north of Munich. No full Ismaning strip or diocesan extent.
sources: Munich-Freising archdiocesan archive: Das weltliche Fuerstentum Freising
options.limits: Not city-exact; Burgrain, Werdenfels and distant estates not automatically included.

options.meaning: Deliberately overbroad Freising-to-Munich strip for conflict screening, not an accepted alternative.
options.limits: Must reject if it takes Munich's native hub; no automatic town-to-town territorial corridor.

options.meaning: Reduced Donaustauf temporal nucleus east of imperial Regensburg, north of the native Danube.
sources: HAB Regensburg I map, leaf 379: episcopal territories versus Bavarian Stadtamhof and Wiesent
options.limits: No Hohenburg or episcopal urban immunity; no fabricated bridge to Woerth.

options.meaning: Reduced Woerth nucleus farther east on the northern Danube-bank sector, same prince-bishop, not a new country.
sources: HAB Regensburg I leaf 379: Woerth, Wiesent and Donaustauf distinguished
options.limits: Narrow Kiefenholz connection and southern districts not reconstructed; the two installed nuclei do not assert that the complete historical territories were wholly disconnected.

options.meaning: Earlier uninstalled continuous hypothesis retained for comparison.
sources: HAB Regensburg I leaf 379: intervening Wiesent and narrow Kiefenholz connector
options.limits: Too coarse to distinguish intervening jurisdictions; replaced by two smaller nuclei, not an arbitrary political corridor.

options.meaning: Small separate imperial-city abstraction on southern Danube-bank approach, west of Donaustauf-Woerth; not cathedral sovereignty.
sources: BSB Cod. icon. 400 after 1700 / HLB urban plan
Official city tourism Stadtamhof: Bavarian north-bank town distinct from imperial city
options.limits: Not an exact urban footprint; immediate abbeys and episcopal immunity cannot be separately rasterized inside it.

options.meaning: Overbroad both-banks city screen; not accepted.
options.limits: Would conflate Bavarian northern Stadtamhof and episcopal/urban land; not a second accepted attribution.
